# Trina Interactive

> Trina Interactive is a small independent game studio. It develops and publishes Slots & Skulls, a turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine, for Windows, macOS and Linux on Steam.

Facts on this site come from the Steam store page and the studio's press kit. Contact: hi@trinainteractive.com

## Games

- [Slots & Skulls](https://trinainteractive.com/slots-and-skulls/): A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Stop the machine to attack, win fights for chests, and upgrade what drops at the forge (if you dare). Or invite a friend and fight them. Steam lists the release date as November 4, 2026. A free demo is available on Steam.
- [Slots & Skulls on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4428910/Slots__Skulls/): store page (app 4428910), Windows, macOS, Linux.
- [Slots & Skulls Demo on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4988090/Slots__Skulls_Demo/): free demo.

## Key facts about Slots & Skulls

- Developer and publisher: Trina Interactive
- Genre: Roguelite, Turn-Based Strategy
- 112 symbols, 33 enemies, ten levels with five fights each
- Forge: upgrade symbols from +0 to +10; a failed upgrade destroys the symbol unless a blue gem is used
- Cats with run-long pacts (one advantage, one disadvantage), six abilities, 21 modifiers
- Online 1v1 with a Steam friend, including a Duel Only mode
- Auto Mode, Auto 2X Mode, and Full Auto Mode in Endless Mode
- Full controller support; 27 supported languages including English and Turkish
